question: What is the meaning of location in building in relation to general information?
description: The Location Core Vocabulary (LOCN) provides a minimum set of classes and properties for describing the name, address, or geometry of a place in relation to general information. This vocabulary is part of the EU ISA Programme Core Vocabularies Working Group (Location Task Force). The status of most properties is 'testing.' (EU ISA Programme Core Vocabularies Working Group (Location Task Force), 2015).

Guide to Passports for the Construction Sector 
46 
 
The international basic standards for linked data contain technical 
specifications for the data formats to be used and the correct design of 
exchangeable information structures. NEN 2660-2 provides a detailed 
elaboration of these standards for information structures applied to 
the construction sector. 
Other initiatives, such as IMBOR (Informatiemodel Beheer Openbare 
Ruimte - Public Space Management Information Model), CB-NL 
(Conceptenbibliotheek Nederland - Dutch library of concepts) and 
Rioned can be linked to these information structures.  
A further explanation of technical specifications, including a practical 
example based on the Longlist of Attributes, can be found in Annex C 
‘On the way to data interoperability’.
